one_off_payments.what: Option fee paid to RadioMedix on signing the option and asset purchase agreement (Nov 2022)
one_off_payments.quote: The Company paid RadioMedix an option fee of $0.8 million upon the execution of the RadioMedix Agreement

financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Private placement of 17,648,596 common shares at $3.40 per share (gross proceeds; net not given; closing date is the expected date from the 8-K)
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: In February 2023, we received $60.0 million in gross proceeds from a private placement financing in which we issued and sold 17,648,596 of our common shares at an offering price of $3.40 per share.

warrants.quote: In connection with entry into the Loan Agreement with Oxford, the Company issued warrants to purchase an aggregate of 196,120 shares of its common shares.
